> zcode-computer-use is a single static Go binary (`cuu`) that gives AI coding
> agents computer control on macOS: an MCP-over-stdio server (`cuu serve`)
> plus a CLI with one JSON-printing verb per tool. Per-window screenshots, an
> indexed accessibility tree with diff markers, element-first actions (AXPress)
> with screenshot-pixel fallback, background observation, content-verified text
> selection, and verified 4-way scroll.

- Install: build once (`cd cuu && go build -o bin/cuu .`), then copy the `mcpServers` JSON from README.md § Install into your MCP client config (`command`: `.../cuu/bin/cuu`, `args`: `["serve"]`)
- Requirements: macOS; Go 1.25+ to build; cliclick (`brew install cliclick`); Accessibility + Screen Recording grants for the host app; scroll uses Apple's bundled /usr/bin/python3 (pyobjc via Xcode CLT) — no other Python at runtime
- Verify: `cd cuu && go test ./...` (golden protocol suite) · `cuu/bin/cuu selftest` (deps + permissions preflight) · legacy v3 suites under `tests/_legacy/` (21 protocol, headless-safe; 31-check live TextEdit E2E)
- Key traps documented: HID-tap wheel events are silently dropped (use kCGSessionEventTap + pixel units); TextEdit ignores scripted AXSelectedTextRange writes (keyboard-walk fallback); CFRelease segfaults in JXA
- License: MIT
